focus: Weak 'that' /ðət/ after reporting verbs · 'said' /sed/ vs 'told' /təʊld/ · weak 'to' in 'told me to' · reporting-verb stress · backshift rhythm
focus_ar: 'that' الخفيفة بعد أفعال النقل، و 'said' مقابل 'told'، و 'to' الخفيفة، ونبر فعل النقل
arabic_challenge: Reported speech drops 'that' to a weak /ðət/ (or omits it), and confuses 'said' (no person) with 'told' (+ person). Arabic learners stress 'that' and mix said/told.

isolation.instructions: After 'said/told/thought' the linking 'that' is weak /ðət/ or dropped entirely: 'He said (that) he was tired'. Never stress it; the reported content carries the meaning.
isolation.instructions_ar: بعد said/told/thought الـ 'that' خفيفة /ðət/ أو تُحذف. متتنبرش أبدًا.
practice: he said ðət he was TIRED
she thought ðət it was TRUE

pair: he said that he was tired (kept)

sentence_practice: He said that he was tired.
She thought that it was true.
They agreed that it was a good idea.
daily_drills.record_this: He said that he was tired and wanted to rest. She thought that it was true, but she wasn't sure. In the end, they all agreed that it was a good idea.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'he said that he was tired'. Is 'that' weak /ðət/ (or droppable), never stressed?

isolation.instructions: 'Said' /sed/ (short /e/) takes NO person directly: 'he said (that)…'. 'Told' /təʊld/ needs a person: 'he told ME…'. Different verb, different pattern.
isolation.instructions_ar: 'said' /sed/ مش بتاخد شخص مباشرة: 'he said…'. 'told' /təʊld/ لازم شخص: 'he told me…'.

daily_drills.record_this: He said he was busy this week. She told me the good news yesterday. They told us to wait outside until the meeting finished.
daily_drills.self_check: Do you use 'told' WITH a person (told me) and 'said' WITHOUT (he said)?

isolation.instructions: Reported commands use 'told/asked + person + to + verb', with weak 'to' /tə/: 'She told me to WAIT'. Stress the person and the action verb.
isolation.instructions_ar: الأوامر المنقولة: 'told/asked + شخص + to + فعل'، والـ 'to' خفيفة: 'She told me to WAIT'.

sentence_practice: She told me to wait here.
He asked us to help him.
daily_drills.record_this: She told me to wait here until she got back. He asked us to help him move the boxes. The doctor advised me to rest and reminded me to take my medicine.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'told me to wait'. Does 'to' reduce to /tə/, with stress on 'wait'?

isolation.instructions: The reporting frame ('he said', 'she told me') is usually light; the REPORTED message is stressed: 'He said he'd be LATE'. The listener cares about the message, not the frame.
isolation.instructions_ar: إطار النقل ('he said') خفيف؛ الرسالة المنقولة هي المنبورة: 'He said he'd be LATE'.
practice: she told me she was LEAVing

sentence_practice: She told me she was leaving.
daily_drills.record_this: He said he'd be late for the meeting. She told me she was leaving the company. They said they'd already eaten, so we didn't cook for them.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'he said he'd be late'. Is the frame light and 'late' the stressed word?

isolation.instructions: When we report, the tense shifts back: 'I am tired' → 'He said he WAS tired'; 'I will call' → 'She said she WOULD call'. Say both aloud to feel the shift; keep the frame weak.
isolation.instructions_ar: عند النقل الزمن يتراجع: 'I am tired' → 'He said he was tired'. كرّرهم بصوت عالي لتحس بالتحوّل.
practice: 'I am tired' → he said he WAS tired
'I will come' → she said she'd COME

sentence_practice: She said she would call later.
daily_drills.record_this: He said he was tired and would go home early. She said she would call me later that evening. They said they had already finished the work, so there was nothing left to do.
daily_drills.self_check: Report a present sentence as past: 'I am busy' → 'He said he was busy.' Did the tense shift back?

challenge_sentences: He said that he was tired and told me to go home.
She told me she would call later.
They said they had already eaten.
The teacher told us to be quiet.
daily_drills.record_this: He said that he was tired and told me to go home without him. She told me she would call later that night. They said they had already eaten, so we relaxed. Earlier, the teacher told us to be quiet during the exam.
daily_drills.self_check: Three checks: weak 'that', said-vs-told used correctly, and the tense shifted back.

test_yourself.instructions: Record yourself reporting a conversation or some news. Then listen back and check each feature.
test_yourself.instructions_ar: سجّل نفسك وانت تنقل محادثة أو خبرًا، وبعدين اسمع وراجع كل نقطة.
test_yourself.passage: Yesterday I met an old friend, and he told me some surprising news. He said that he had left his job and was starting his own business. He told me he had been planning it for years. I asked him why, and he explained that he wanted more freedom. He said it would be difficult at first, but he thought it was worth it. He told me not to worry about him and asked me to visit his new office soon. I said I would come next week. He seemed happy, and he told me he had never felt so sure about anything.

sounds_to_check.weak 'that': said that he had left, explained that he wanted, thought that it was worth
sounds_to_check.said vs told: he told me, he said, I asked him, I said
sounds_to_check.weak 'to' in commands: told me not to worry, asked me to visit
sounds_to_check.reporting frame weak, message strong: he SAID he had LEFT his JOB
sounds_to_check.backshift: had left, was starting, had been planning, wanted, would be, had never felt

scoring_guide.90_100: 'that' weak, said/told correct, commands with weak 'to', backshift natural. Ready for week 12.
scoring_guide.50_69: said/told mixed, or tense not shifted. Repeat days 2 and 5.
scoring_guide.below_50: Redo days 1-5, reporting short sentences aloud with the tense shift.

for_arabic_speakers: The linking 'that' is weak /ðət/ and can be dropped — never stress it.
'told' needs a person (told me); 'said' does not (he said).
Reported commands: told/asked + person + weak 'to' + verb.
Report present as past (backshift): 'I am' → 'he said he was'; 'will' → 'would'.
supplementary_notes.recording_requirement: Record the 'record_this' line daily; compare day 7 with day 1.
